note: First end-to-end model to top OmniDocBench v1.6 (paper Overall 96.58, arXiv 2607.13639). 0.8B params: Qwen3-VL vision encoder on a Qwen3-Next GDN (gated-delta-net) hybrid backbone (model_type qwen3_5). Served in-process via vLLM 0.19.0 on gfx1100; GDN runs via the Triton/FLA prefill kernel. Reproduced Overall 95.87 on the full 1651-page set — #1 in the zone. Three of four metrics are essentially perfect (text 0.0256 vs 0.025, reading-order 0.1111 vs 0.111, table TEDS 94.75 vs 94.76). The 0.71-pt gap vs the paper is entirely formula CDM (95.41 vs 97.53), a verified vLLM-0.19.0-vs-0.22.1 formula-segmentation artifact on 26 of 2352 formulas (median CDM 1.0); closing it requires a vLLM 0.22.1 ROCm build (the card's pinned version), a follow-on.
